title: Quiet and Comfy East Nashville 2BR/1BA Home
description:
Quiet residential neighborhood close to East Nashville restaurants/retail. My grandparents bought this home new in 1954 and it’s been my home since 2010. 
Many original features remain, others have been updated (stainless appliances including dishwasher, for example). Large living/dining room, full kitchen, 2 bedrooms and 1 bathroom. Driveway for up to 4 cars. Guests have private access to full main floor of home (I travel often and will not be on site during your stay). Valid STR Permit.

The space
Guests enter through front door (up 4 steps to sidewalk and up 7 steps to porch)
Bedroom 1 - King bed with dressing table/mirror
Bedroom 2 - King bed with closet, dressing table/mirror, and desk
(Charging station in each bedroom)
Living Room - TV with Roku (Netflix included - no cable/antenna channels) / Couch and 3 Chairs
Dining Room - Table and 4 Chairs
Full Kitchen - Fridge / Oven / Dishwasher / Microwave / Coffeemaker / Toaster/ Dishes,  Cookware and Utensils
Bathroom - Towels / Shampoo, Conditioner and Body Soap / Hair Dryer /Clothes Steamer / Iron

Guest access
Guests have private access to full main floor of home and driveway. The basement (my office) is locked and not accessible by guests.

Other things to note
Additional dates may be available - Please reach out by message if a date you're interested in is blocked on the availability calendar.
